statement: On curated human GPCR families outside Boltz's reported training distribution, receptor backbones were often accurate while ligand poses could contain consequential local errors; physics-based refinement improved poses and rescued downstream FEP+ agreement toward native-structure performance.
locator: Abstract and Results; npj Drug Discovery 3, 30 (2026)
notes: Supports hybrid ML-plus-physics as an empirically grounded direction; open replication should not depend on proprietary FEP+.
